correctness.rationale: Direct symbolic decomposition of the complete four-variable Jacobian produces p_plus(z)=z^2-tau*z+(u^2-4-2*tau) and p_minus(z)=z^2+(2d+2+w)z+(4d+2w+u^2), where tau=w-2d-2. Positive parameter assumptions strictly imply p_minus is Hurwitz; p_plus is Hurwitz for tau<0, unstable for tau>0, and has simple nonzero imaginary roots for tau=0. On the exact invariant center plane a canonical planar calculation gives l1=-du/[4(u+2)]<0, while the crossing speed is 1/2. Standard nondegenerate supercritical Hopf and stable transverse Floquet theory give the claimed strictly positive attracting cycles for all small tau>0. verify_stage_hopf.py passed all analytic-identity assertions and 20 rational consistency cases; those cases are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The sign/zero-mean structure of interactions in the motivating stage-structured literature makes the existence of an attracting oscillatory branch despite zero aggregate cross-species coupling a natural question. This result supplies an exact full-dimensional supercritical bifurcation boundary for a nontrivial open range u>2,d>u+2 and an algebraically strict, universal sign for the cubic coefficient. The finite-demography threshold is absent from averaging and meaningful as a nonlinear stability boundary; it is neither a numerical witness nor a routine relabeling. The result is local; global ecological relevance is not claimed.
